defective_pattern: Using raw English in-text citations or transliterated foreign author citations without corresponding native OpenXML footnotes.
why_defective: Violates Persian academic citation standards which require phonetic transliteration of foreign authors in the text alongside an immediate footnote containing the original English name to maintain traceability and RTL integrity.
observed_symptoms: English author names like '(Smith, 2021)' appearing in Persian text.
Persian transliterations like '(اسمیت، 2021)' without a corresponding footnote providing 'Smith'.
corrective_remedy: Transliterate foreign author names in the Persian text (e.g., 'اسمیت و همکاران، ۲۰۲۱') and immediately attach a native OpenXML footnote with the original English name.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of English citations or missing footnote linkage for transliterated citations.
